latin_ascii: tinii tomara upara emana kitava nayila karechena, yara katipaya ayata maulika-suspasta arthavodhaka, egulo hala kitavera mula ara anyagulo puropuri spasta naya; kintu yadera antare vakrata ache, tara golayoga srstira uddesye evam bhula vyakhyara uddesye ukta ayatagulora anusarana kare yegulo puropuri spasta naya. mulata: era marma allaha chara keui jane na. yara jnane sugabhira tara vale ye, amara tara upara imana enechi, e savakichui amadera pratipalakera nikata hate eseche, mulatah jnanavana vyaktira chara keui nasihata grahana kare na.

latin_iast: he āmādera pratipālaka! sat patha pradarśanera pare tumi āmādera antaraguloke vakra kare dio nā, āmāderake tomāra nikaṭa hate rahamata pradāna kara, mūlataḥ tumii mahāna dātā.
latin_ascii: he amadera pratipalaka! sat patha pradarsanera pare tumi amadera antaraguloke vakra kare dio na, amaderake tomara nikata hate rahamata pradana kara, mulatah tumii mahana data.

latin_iast: he āmādera pratipālaka! niścaẏai tumi samudaẏa mānuṣake ekadina samaveta karave, yāte konao sandeha nāi. niścaẏai āllāha aṅgīkārera khelāpha karena nā.
latin_ascii: he amadera pratipalaka! niscayai tumi samudaya manusake ekadina samaveta karave, yate konao sandeha nai. niscayai allaha angikarera khelapha karena na.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā kupharī kare tādera dhana-sampada o santāna-santati āllāhara sāmane kona kāje lāgave nā evaṃ tārāi āgunera indhana.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara kuphari kare tadera dhana-sampada o santana-santati allahara samane kona kaje lagave na evam tarai agunera indhana.

latin_iast: tādera svabhāva pherāonī dala evaṃ tādera āgera lokedera mata yārā āmāra āẏātaguloke mithyā pratipanna kareche; sutarāṃ āllāha tādera gunāhera daruna tāderake pākar̤āo karalena, āllāha śāsti dāne atyanta kaṭhora.
latin_ascii: tadera svabhava pheraoni dala evam tadera agera lokedera mata yara amara ayataguloke mithya pratipanna kareche; sutaram allaha tadera gunahera daruna taderake pakarao karalena, allaha sasti dane atyanta kathora.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare tāderake vale dāo, ‘tomarā acirei parājita have āra tomāderake jāhānnāmera dike hā~kāno have, oṭā katai nā nikṛṣṭa āvāsasthāna’!
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare taderake vale dao, ‘tomara acirei parajita have ara tomaderake jahannamera dike ha~kano have, ota katai na nikrsta avasasthana’!

latin_iast: tomādera janya avaśyai nidarśana āche sei du’dala sainyera madhye yārā paraspara pratidvandīrūpe dā~r̤iẏechila (vadara prāntare). ekadala āllāhara pathe yuddha karechila evaṃ aparadala chila kāphira, kāphirarā musalimaderake prakāśya cokhe dviguṇa dekhachila. āllāha yāke icche svīẏa sāhāyyera dvārā śaktiśālī kare thākena, niścaẏai ete dṛṣṭimānadera janya śikṣā raẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomadera janya avasyai nidarsana ache sei du’dala sainyera madhye yara paraspara pratidvandirupe da~riyechila (vadara prantare). ekadala allahara pathe yuddha karechila evam aparadala chila kaphira, kaphirara musalimaderake prakasya cokhe dviguna dekhachila. allaha yake icche sviya sahayyera dvara saktisali kare thakena, niscayai ete drstimanadera janya siksa rayeche.

latin_iast: mānuṣera kāche suśobhita karā haẏeche nārī, santāna, sttapīkṛta svarṇa o raupyabhānḍāra, cihnayukta aśvarāji, gṛhapālita paśu evaṃ śasyakṣetra, esava pārthiva jīvanera sampada, āra āllāha -tā~rai nikaṭa raẏeche uttama āśraẏasthala.
latin_ascii: manusera kache susobhita kara hayeche nari, santana, sttapikrta svarna o raupyabhandara, cihnayukta asvaraji, grhapalita pasu evam sasyaksetra, esava parthiva jivanera sampada, ara allaha -ta~rai nikata rayeche uttama asrayasthala.

latin_iast: vala, āmi ki tomāderake e sava hateo ati uttama kona kichura saṃvāda deva? yārā muttākī tādera janya tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa emana vāgāna raẏeche, yāra nimne nadī pravāhita, tārā tāte cirakāla thākave āra raẏeche pavitra saṅgī evaṃ āllāhara santuṣṭi, vastutaḥ āllāha vāndāgaṇera samparke samyaka draṣṭā.
latin_ascii: vala, ami ki tomaderake e sava hateo ati uttama kona kichura samvada devay yara muttaki tadera janya tadera pratipalakera nikata emana vagana rayeche, yara nimne nadi pravahita, tara tate cirakala thakave ara rayeche pavitra sangi evam allahara santusti, vastutah allaha vandaganera samparke samyaka drasta.

latin_iast: yārā prārthanā kare, ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āmarā īmāna enechi, ataeva āmādera gunāhasamūha kṣamā kara evaṃ āmāderake jāhānnāmera śāsti hate rakṣā kara’.
latin_ascii: yara prarthana kare, ‘he amadera pratipalaka! amara imana enechi, ataeva amadera gunahasamuha ksama kara evam amaderake jahannamera sasti hate raksa kara’.

latin_iast: tārā dhairyaśīla, satyavādī, (āllāhara prati) ājñāvaha, (āllāhara pathe) vyaẏakārī evaṃ śeṣa rāte kṣamāprārthanākārī.
latin_ascii: tara dhairyasila, satyavadi, (allahara prati) ajnavaha, (allahara pathe) vyayakari evam sesa rate ksamaprarthanakari.

latin_iast: āllāha sākṣya dena ye, tini chār̤ā satyikāra kona ilāha nei evaṃ phereśatāgaṇa o nyāẏanītite pratiṣṭhita jñānīgaṇao (sākṣya dicche ye,) tini chār̤ā satyikāra kona ilāha nei, tini mahāparākrānta, mahājñānī.
latin_ascii: allaha saksya dena ye, tini chara satyikara kona ilaha nei evam pheresatagana o nyayanitite pratisthita jnaniganao (saksya dicche ye,) tini chara satyikara kona ilaha nei, tini mahaparakranta, mahajnani.

latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāhara nikaṭa ekamātra dvīna hala isalāma. vastutaḥ yāderake kitāva deẏā haẏechila tārā jñāna lābhera para eke anyera upara prādhānya lābhera janya matabheda sṛṣṭi kareche evaṃ ye vyakti āllāhara nidarśanasamūhke asvīkāra karave, (se jene nika) niścaẏai āllāha hisāva grahaṇe atiśaẏa tatpara.
latin_ascii: niscaya allahara nikata ekamatra dvina hala isalama. vastutah yaderake kitava deya hayechila tara jnana labhera para eke anyera upara pradhanya labhera janya matabheda srsti kareche evam ye vyakti allahara nidarsanasamuhke asvikara karave, (se jene nika) niscayai allaha hisava grahane atisaya tatpara.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi (āhale kitāva) tomāra sāthe tarka kare tave vale dāo, ‘āmi āllāhara nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa karechi āra āmāra anusārīgaṇao ātmasamarpaṇa kareche evaṃ āhale kitāva o ummīgaṇake vala, ‘tomarā ki ātmasamarpaṇa karecha’? ataḥpara yadi tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare tave niścaẏai tārā patha pāve āra tārā yadi mukha phiriẏe neẏa, tave tomāra dāẏitva śudhu pracāra karā. āllāha vāndādera samparke samyaka draṣṭā.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadi (ahale kitava) tomara sathe tarka kare tave vale dao, ‘ami allahara nikata atmasamarpana karechi ara amara anusariganao atmasamarpana kareche evam ahale kitava o ummiganake vala, ‘tomara ki atmasamarpana karecha’y atahpara yadi tara atmasamarpana kare tave niscayai tara patha pave ara tara yadi mukha phiriye neya, tave tomara dayitva sudhu pracara kara. allaha vandadera samparke samyaka drasta.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara āẏātasamūhake amānya kare, nāvīderake anyāẏabhāve hatyā kare evaṃ mānuṣadera madhye yārā nyāẏa-nīti śikṣā deẏa tāderake hatyā kare, tāderake yantraṇādāẏaka śāstira saṃvāda dāo.
latin_ascii: yara allahara ayatasamuhake amanya kare, naviderake anyayabhave hatya kare evam manusadera madhye yara nyaya-niti siksa deya taderake hatya kare, taderake yantranadayaka sastira samvada dao.

latin_iast: erāi tārā yādera samudaẏa ‘āmāla duniẏā o ākherāte niṣphala have evaṃ tādera kona sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: erai tara yadera samudaya ‘amala duniya o akherate nisphala have evam tadera kona sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati dṛṣṭi nikṣepa karani yāderake kitāvera aṃśa deẏā haẏechila? tāderake āllāhara kitāvera dike āhavāna karā haẏechila, yāte eṭā tādera madhye mīmāṃsā kare deẏa, erapara tādera ekadala vimukhatā avalamvana kare phire yāẏa.
latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati drsti niksepa karani yaderake kitavera amsa deya hayechilay taderake allahara kitavera dike ahavana kara hayechila, yate eta tadera madhye mimamsa kare deya, erapara tadera ekadala vimukhata avalamvana kare phire yaya.

latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, tārā vale, dina kataka chār̤ā jāhānnāmera āguna kakṣano āmāderake sparśa karave nā evaṃ tādera kalpita dhāraṇāsamūha dvīnera vyāpāre tāderake dho~kāẏa phele rekheche.
latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, tara vale, dina kataka chara jahannamera aguna kaksano amaderake sparsa karave na evam tadera kalpita dharanasamuha dvinera vyapare taderake dho~kaya phele rekheche.

latin_iast: anantara tādera kī daśā ghaṭave, yakhana āmi tāderake sei dine ekatrita karava, ye dinaṭi saṃghaṭita haoẏāra vyāpāre konai sandeha nei evaṃ pratyekake tāra arjita pratiphala pūrṇabhāve deẏā have āra tādera prati kona yulama karā have nā.
latin_ascii: anantara tadera ki dasa ghatave, yakhana ami taderake sei dine ekatrita karava, ye dinati samghatita haoyara vyapare konai sandeha nei evam pratyekake tara arjita pratiphala purnabhave deya have ara tadera prati kona yulama kara have na.

latin_iast: vala, ‘he āllāha! tumi samudaẏa rājyera mālika, yāke icche rājya dāna kara āra yāra theke icche rājya ker̤e nāo evaṃ yāke icche sammānita kara āra yāke icche apadastha kara, tomārai hāte sava rakama kalyāṇa, niścaẏai tumi sakala vastura upara kṣamatāvāna’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘he allaha! tumi samudaya rajyera malika, yake icche rajya dana kara ara yara theke icche rajya kere nao evam yake icche sammanita kara ara yake icche apadastha kara, tomarai hate sava rakama kalyana, niscayai tumi sakala vastura upara ksamatavana’.

latin_iast: tumii rātake dinera bhitara āra dinake rātera bhitara ḍhukiẏe dāo, tumii jīvitake mṛta hate vera kara evaṃ mṛtake jīvita hate vera kara āra yāke icche vehisāva riykva dāna kara.
latin_ascii: tumii ratake dinera bhitara ara dinake ratera bhitara dhukiye dao, tumii jivitake mrta hate vera kara evam mrtake jivita hate vera kara ara yake icche vehisava riykva dana kara.

latin_iast: mu’minagaṇa yena mu’minagaṇa chār̤ā kāphiradera saṅge vandhutva nā kare, mūlataḥ ye emana karave āllāhara sāthe tāra kona kichurai samparka nei, tave vyatikrama hala yadi tomarā tādera yulama hate ātmarakṣāra janya satarkatā avalamvana kara. āra āllāha tā~ra nijera samvandhe tomāderake sāvadhāna karachena evaṃ āllāharai dike pratyāvartana.
latin_ascii: mu’minagana yena mu’minagana chara kaphiradera sange vandhutva na kare, mulatah ye emana karave allahara sathe tara kona kichurai samparka nei, tave vyatikrama hala yadi tomara tadera yulama hate atmaraksara janya satarkata avalamvana kara. ara allaha ta~ra nijera samvandhe tomaderake savadhana karachena evam allaharai dike pratyavartana.

latin_iast: vala, ‘tomarā tomādera antarera viṣaẏake gopana kara athavā prakāśa kara, āllāha tā jānena, āra tini jānena yā kichu ākāśasamūhe evaṃ bhūbhāge āche; āllāha sakala vastura upara kṣamatāvāna’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘tomara tomadera antarera visayake gopana kara athava prakasa kara, allaha ta janena, ara tini janena ya kichu akasasamuhe evam bhubhage ache; allaha sakala vastura upara ksamatavana’.

latin_iast: ye dina pratyeka ātmā yā kichu neka ‘āmāla kareche evaṃ yā kichu vada ‘āmāla kareche tā vidyamāna pāve; sei ātmā kāmanā karave yadi tāra evaṃ ora (arthāt tāra manda karmaphalera) madhye dustara vyavadhāna hata. āllāha tā~ra nijera samparke tomāderake sāvadhāna karachena, vastutaḥ āllāha vāndāgaṇera prati khuvai karuṇāśīla.
latin_ascii: ye dina pratyeka atma ya kichu neka ‘amala kareche evam ya kichu vada ‘amala kareche ta vidyamana pave; sei atma kamana karave yadi tara evam ora (arthat tara manda karmaphalera) madhye dustara vyavadhana hata. allaha ta~ra nijera samparke tomaderake savadhana karachena, vastutah allaha vandaganera prati khuvai karunasila.

latin_iast: vale dāo, ‘yadi tomarā āllāhake bhālavāsa, tave āmāra anusaraṇa kara, āllāha tomāderake bhālavāsavena evaṃ tomādera gunāhasakala kṣamā karavena, vastutaḥ āllāha ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu’.
latin_ascii: vale dao, ‘yadi tomara allahake bhalavasa, tave amara anusarana kara, allaha tomaderake bhalavasavena evam tomadera gunahasakala ksama karavena, vastutah allaha ati ksamasila, parama dayalu’.

latin_iast: vala, ‘tomarā āllāhara o rasūlera ājñāvaha hao’. ataḥpara yadi tārā nā māne, tave (jene rekha) āllāha kāphiraderake bhālavāsena nā.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘tomara allahara o rasulera ajnavaha hao’. atahpara yadi tara na mane, tave (jene rekha) allaha kaphiraderake bhalavasena na.

latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha ādāma o nūhake evaṃ ivarāhīmera o ‘imarānera gotrake viśvajagatera upara manonīta karechena.
latin_ascii: niscayai allaha adama o nuhake evam ivarahimera o ‘imaranera gotrake visvajagatera upara manonita karechena.

latin_iast: erā eke anyera vaṃśadhara evaṃ āllāha sarvaśrotā o sarvajña.
latin_ascii: era eke anyera vamsadhara evam allaha sarvasrota o sarvajna.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana ‘imarānera strī āraya karechila, he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāra udare yā āche, tāke āmi ekānta tomāra uddeśe utsarga karalāma, kājei āmāra pakṣa hate tā grahaṇa kara, niścaẏai tumi sarvaśrotā o sarvajña.
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana ‘imaranera stri araya karechila, he amara pratipalaka! amara udare ya ache, take ami ekanta tomara uddese utsarga karalama, kajei amara paksa hate ta grahana kara, niscayai tumi sarvasrota o sarvajna.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se tāke prasava karala, vale uṭhala, he āmāra pratipālaka! āmi kanyā prasava karechi evaṃ āllāha bhāla karei jānena yā se prasava kareche; vastutaḥ putra kanyāra mata naẏa evaṃ āmi tāra nāma rākhalāma māraiẏāma evaṃ āmi tāke o tāra vaṃśadharake vitār̤ita śaẏatvāna hate tomāra āśraẏe cher̤e dilāma.
latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se take prasava karala, vale uthala, he amara pratipalaka! ami kanya prasava karechi evam allaha bhala karei janena ya se prasava kareche; vastutah putra kanyara mata naya evam ami tara nama rakhalama maraiyama evam ami take o tara vamsadharake vitarita sayatvana hate tomara asraye chere dilama.

latin_iast: takhana tāra pratipālaka tāke santuṣṭi sahakāre grahaṇa karalena evaṃ tāke uttamarūpe lālana pālana karalena evaṃ yākāriẏāke tāra tattvāvadhāẏaka karalena. yakhanai yākāriẏā māraiẏāmera kakṣe praveśa karata, tāra kāche khādya sāmagrī dekhate peta; jijñesa karata- he māraiẏāma! ‘esava kottheke tomāra kāche āse’? māraiẏāma valata, ‘osava āllāhara nikaṭa hate (āse)’. niścaẏai āllāha yāke icche vehisāva riyaka dāna karena.
latin_ascii: takhana tara pratipalaka take santusti sahakare grahana karalena evam take uttamarupe lalana palana karalena evam yakariyake tara tattvavadhayaka karalena. yakhanai yakariya maraiyamera kakse pravesa karata, tara kache khadya samagri dekhate peta; jijnesa karata- he maraiyama! ‘esava kottheke tomara kache ase’y maraiyama valata, ‘osava allahara nikata hate (ase)’. niscayai allaha yake icche vehisava riyaka dana karena.

latin_iast: okhānei yākāriẏā nija pratipālakera kāche prārthanā kare valala, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke tomāra pakṣa hate ekaṭi susantāna dāna kara. niścaẏa tumi prārthanā śravaṇakārī’.
latin_ascii: okhanei yakariya nija pratipalakera kache prarthana kare valala, ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake tomara paksa hate ekati susantana dana kara. niscaya tumi prarthana sravanakari’.

latin_iast: yakhana yākāriẏā ‘ivādāta kakṣe salāte danḍāẏamāna takhana phereśatārā tāke samvodhana kare valala : āllāha tomāke iẏāhiẏā’ra susaṃvāda dicchena, se have āllāhara pakṣa hate āgata kālemāra satyatāra sākṣyadātā, netā, gunāha hate virata o neka vāndāgaṇera madhya hate ekajana nāvī.
latin_ascii: yakhana yakariya ‘ivadata kakse salate dandayamana takhana pheresatara take samvodhana kare valala : allaha tomake iyahiya’ra susamvada dicchena, se have allahara paksa hate agata kalemara satyatara saksyadata, neta, gunaha hate virata o neka vandaganera madhya hate ekajana navi.

latin_iast: yākāriẏā valala, he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāra santāna have kībhāve, āmi to vārdhakye pau~chechi evaṃ āmāra strīo vandhyā. tini valalena, ‘ebhāvei, āllāha yā icche karena tā-i sampanna kare thākena’.
latin_ascii: yakariya valala, he amara pratipalaka! amara santana have kibhave, ami to vardhakye pau~chechi evam amara strio vandhya. tini valalena, ‘ebhavei, allaha ya icche karena ta-i sampanna kare thakena’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāra janya kona nidarśana dāo’. tini valalena, ‘tomāra janya nidarśana ei ye, tinadina tumi iśārā chār̤ā lokera saṅge kathā valate pārave nā evaṃ tomāra pratipālakake adhika smaraṇa karave evaṃ sakāle o sandhyāẏa tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karave’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he amara pratipalaka! amara janya kona nidarsana dao’. tini valalena, ‘tomara janya nidarsana ei ye, tinadina tumi isara chara lokera sange katha valate parave na evam tomara pratipalakake adhika smarana karave evam sakale o sandhyaya ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana karave’.

latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana phereśatārā valechila, ‘he māraiẏāma! āllāha tomāke veche niẏechena evaṃ tomāke pavitra karechena, āra tāmāma duniẏāra nārīdera upara tomāke manonīta karechena’.
latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana pheresatara valechila, ‘he maraiyama! allaha tomake veche niyechena evam tomake pavitra karechena, ara tamama duniyara naridera upara tomake manonita karechena’.

latin_iast: he māraiẏāma! ‘tumi tomāra pratipālakera anugata hao, sājadāha kara evaṃ rukū‘kārīdera saṅge rukū‘ kara’.
latin_ascii: he maraiyama! ‘tumi tomara pratipalakera anugata hao, sajadaha kara evam ruku‘karidera sange ruku‘ kara’.

latin_iast: esava adṛśyera saṃvāda, āmi tomāra kāche tā oẏāhī dvārā pau~che dicchi. vastutaḥ tumi tādera nikaṭa upasthita chile nā yakhana tādera kon vyakti māraiẏāmake lālana-pālana karave sei bhāgya nirṇaẏera janya kalama nikṣepa karachila evaṃ tumi tādera nikaṭa upasthita chile nā, yakhana tārā (māraiẏāmera abhibhāvaka ke have tā niẏe) vādānuvāda karachila.
latin_ascii: esava adrsyera samvada, ami tomara kache ta oyahi dvara pau~che dicchi. vastutah tumi tadera nikata upasthita chile na yakhana tadera kon vyakti maraiyamake lalana-palana karave sei bhagya nirnayera janya kalama niksepa karachila evam tumi tadera nikata upasthita chile na, yakhana tara (maraiyamera abhibhavaka ke have ta niye) vadanuvada karachila.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana phereśatārā valala, ‘he māraiẏāma! niścaẏa āllāha tomāke tā~ra ekaṭi kathāra susaṃvāda dicchena. tāra nāma māraiẏāmera putra īsā-masīha, se duniẏā o ākherāte sammānita o sānnidhya prāptadera antarbhukta have.’
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana pheresatara valala, ‘he maraiyama! niscaya allaha tomake ta~ra ekati kathara susamvada dicchena. tara nama maraiyamera putra isa-masiha, se duniya o akherate sammanita o sannidhya praptadera antarbhukta have.’

latin_iast: ‘se lokedera sāthe dolanā thākā avasthāẏa evaṃ vaẏoḥprāpta avasthāẏa kathā valave evaṃ neka vāndādera antargata have.
latin_ascii: ‘se lokedera sathe dolana thaka avasthaya evam vayohprapta avasthaya katha valave evam neka vandadera antargata have.

latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! kībhāve āmāra putra have, athaca āmāke kona mānava sparśa kareni’. tini valalena, ‘ebhāvei’ āllāha sṛjana karena yā tini icche karena, tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘‘haẏe yāo’’ sutarāṃ tā haẏe yāẏa.
latin_ascii: maraiyama valala, ‘he amara pratipalaka! kibhave amara putra have, athaca amake kona manava sparsa kareni’. tini valalena, ‘ebhavei’ allaha srjana karena ya tini icche karena, tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘‘haye yao’’ sutaram ta haye yaya.

latin_iast: āra tini tāke kitāva, hikamāta, tāorāta o iñjila śikṣā devena.
latin_ascii: ara tini take kitava, hikamata, taorata o injila siksa devena.

latin_iast: ‘āra tini tāke vānī isarāīlera nikaṭa rasūla hiseve preraṇa karavena’. se valave, ‘niścaẏa āmi tomādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate nidarśanasaha tomādera nikaṭa esechi, āmi tomādera janya māṭi dvārā pākhīra mata ekaṭā kāẏā gaṭhana karava, ataḥpara tāte phu~tkāra deva, phale āllāhara hukume tā pākhi haẏe yāve evaṃ āllāhara hukume āmi janmāndha o kuṣṭharogīke ārogya karava o āllāhara hukume mṛtake jīvita karava evaṃ āmi tomāderake vale deva tomādera gṛhe tomarā yā āhāra kara evaṃ sañcaẏa kare rākha; niścaẏai e kāje tomādera janya nidarśana raẏeche, yadi tomarā mu’mina hao.’
latin_ascii: ‘ara tini take vani isarailera nikata rasula hiseve prerana karavena’. se valave, ‘niscaya ami tomadera pratipalakera paksa hate nidarsanasaha tomadera nikata esechi, ami tomadera janya mati dvara pakhira mata ekata kaya gathana karava, atahpara tate phu~tkara deva, phale allahara hukume ta pakhi haye yave evam allahara hukume ami janmandha o kustharogike arogya karava o allahara hukume mrtake jivita karava evam ami tomaderake vale deva tomadera grhe tomara ya ahara kara evam sancaya kare rakha; niscayai e kaje tomadera janya nidarsana rayeche, yadi tomara mu’mina hao.’

latin_iast: ‘(āra āmi esechi) āmāra sāmane tāorātera nidarśana yā raẏeche tāra samarthakarūpe yena tomādera janya kona kona jinisa hālāla kare dei yā tomādera prati hārāma chila evaṃ āmi tomādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate nidarśanasaha tomādera nikaṭa esechi, kājei tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ āmāke anusaraṇa kara’.
latin_ascii: ‘(ara ami esechi) amara samane taoratera nidarsana ya rayeche tara samarthakarupe yena tomadera janya kona kona jinisa halala kare dei ya tomadera prati harama chila evam ami tomadera pratipalakera paksa hate nidarsanasaha tomadera nikata esechi, kajei tomara allahake bhaya kara evam amake anusarana kara’.

latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āllāha āmāra pratipālaka evaṃ tomāderao pratipālaka, ataeva tā~ra ‘ivādāta kara, eṭāi sarala patha’.
latin_ascii: ‘niscaya allaha amara pratipalaka evam tomaderao pratipalaka, ataeva ta~ra ‘ivadata kara, etai sarala patha’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara ‘īsā yakhana tādera aviśvāsa anubhava karala, takhana valala, ‘keu āche ki ye āllāhara pathe āmāra sahāẏaka have’. hāoẏārīgaṇa valala, ‘āmarāi āllāhara sāhāyyakārī, āmarā āllāhara prati īmāna enechi evaṃ sākṣī thākuna ye, āmarā ātmasamarpaṇakārī’.
latin_ascii: atahpara ‘isa yakhana tadera avisvasa anubhava karala, takhana valala, ‘keu ache ki ye allahara pathe amara sahayaka have’. haoyarigana valala, ‘amarai allahara sahayyakari, amara allahara prati imana enechi evam saksi thakuna ye, amara atmasamarpanakari’.

latin_iast: ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! tumi yā avatīrṇa karecha āmarā tāra upara īmāna enechi, rasūlera ānugatya svīkāra karechi, sutarāṃ āmāderake sākṣyadānakārīdera madhye lipivaddha kara.’
latin_ascii: ‘he amadera pratipalaka! tumi ya avatirna karecha amara tara upara imana enechi, rasulera anugatya svikara karechi, sutaram amaderake saksyadanakaridera madhye lipivaddha kara.’

latin_iast: evaṃ tārā kauśala karechila evaṃ āllāho (javāve) kauśala karechilena, āllāha kauśalīdera śreṣṭha.
latin_ascii: evam tara kausala karechila evam allaho (javave) kausala karechilena, allaha kausalidera srestha.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana āllāha ‘īsāke valechilena, ‘he ‘īsā! āmi tomāra sāthe kṛta oẏādā pūrṇa karava (tomāke mṛtyu chār̤āi duniẏā theke kavaja karava) evaṃ tomāke āmāra kāche uṭhiẏe neva evaṃ tomāke kāphiradera hate mukta karava āra tomāra anusaraṇakārīderake kviẏāmāta paryanta aviśvāsīdera upara vijaẏī rākhava; ataḥpara āmāra kāche tomādera pratyāvartana, takhana āmi tomādera madhye phāẏasālā kare deva ye viṣaẏe tomarā matabheda karacha.’
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana allaha ‘isake valechilena, ‘he ‘isa! ami tomara sathe krta oyada purna karava (tomake mrtyu charai duniya theke kavaja karava) evam tomake amara kache uthiye neva evam tomake kaphiradera hate mukta karava ara tomara anusaranakariderake kviyamata paryanta avisvasidera upara vijayi rakhava; atahpara amara kache tomadera pratyavartana, takhana ami tomadera madhye phayasala kare deva ye visaye tomara matabheda karacha.’

latin_iast: ataḥpara yārā aviśvāsī, tāderake duniẏā o ākherāte kaṭhora śāsti deva evaṃ keui tādera sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: atahpara yara avisvasi, taderake duniya o akherate kathora sasti deva evam keui tadera sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: pakṣāntare yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ sat kāja kareche, tāderake tini puropuri sāoẏāva dāna karavena, vastutaḥ āllāha yālimaderake bhālavāsena nā.
latin_ascii: paksantare yara imana eneche evam sat kaja kareche, taderake tini puropuri saoyava dana karavena, vastutah allaha yalimaderake bhalavasena na.

latin_iast: esava āmi tomāke par̤e śunācchi āẏātasamaṣṭi o jñānagarbha vāṇī hate.
latin_ascii: esava ami tomake pare sunacchi ayatasamasti o jnanagarbha vani hate.

latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa īsāra avasthā ādāmera avasthāra mata, māṭi dvārā tāke gaṭhana kare tāke hukuma karalena, haẏe yāo, phale se haẏe gela.
latin_ascii: allahara nikata isara avastha adamera avasthara mata, mati dvara take gathana kare take hukuma karalena, haye yao, phale se haye gela.

latin_iast: e vāstava ghaṭanā tomāra pratipālakera pakṣa hatei, sutarāṃ tumi saṃśaẏakārīdera antarbhukta haẏo nā.
latin_ascii: e vastava ghatana tomara pratipalakera paksa hatei, sutaram tumi samsayakaridera antarbhukta hayo na.

latin_iast: tomāra nikaṭa jñāna āsāra para ye vyakti tomāra sāthe (īsāra samvandhe) vitarka karave tāke vala, ‘āso, āmādera putraderake evaṃ tomādera putraderake āra āmādera nārīderake evaṃ tomādera nārīderake evaṃ āmādera nijederake evaṃ tomādera nijederake āhavāna kari, ataḥpara āmarā muvāhalā kari āra mithyukadera prati āllāhara abhisampāta varṣaṇa kari.
latin_ascii: tomara nikata jnana asara para ye vyakti tomara sathe (isara samvandhe) vitarka karave take vala, ‘aso, amadera putraderake evam tomadera putraderake ara amadera nariderake evam tomadera nariderake evam amadera nijederake evam tomadera nijederake ahavana kari, atahpara amara muvahala kari ara mithyukadera prati allahara abhisampata varsana kari.

latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭā prakṛta ghaṭanā. āllāha chār̤ā anya satya ilāha nei. āra niścaẏai āllāha mahāparākrānta, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: niscayai eta prakrta ghatana. allaha chara anya satya ilaha nei. ara niscayai allaha mahaparakranta, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: tā’ sattveo yadi tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa, tave niścaẏai āllāha kalaha sṛṣṭikārīdera viṣaẏe viśeṣabhāve avahita.
latin_ascii: ta’ sattveo yadi tara mukha phiriye neya, tave niscayai allaha kalaha srstikaridera visaye visesabhave avahita.

latin_iast: vala, ‘he āhale kitāva! emana eka kathāra dike āso, yā āmādera o tomādera madhye ekai, tā ei ye, āmarā āllāha bhinna anya kāro ‘ivādāta karava nā evaṃ kona kichuke tā~ra śarīka karava nā evaṃ āllāhake vāda diẏe āmādera madhye keu kāuke rava hiseve grahaṇa karava nā. tāraparao yadi tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa tave vale dāo, tomarā e viṣaẏe sākṣī thāka ye, āmarā ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘he ahale kitava! emana eka kathara dike aso, ya amadera o tomadera madhye ekai, ta ei ye, amara allaha bhinna anya karo ‘ivadata karava na evam kona kichuke ta~ra sarika karava na evam allahake vada diye amadera madhye keu kauke rava hiseve grahana karava na. taraparao yadi tara mukha phiriye neya tave vale dao, tomara e visaye saksi thaka ye, amara atmasamarpanakari.

latin_iast: he āhale kitāva! tomarā kena ivarāhīma samparke tarka karacha? tāorāta evaṃ iñjila to tāraparei avatīrṇa haẏeche, tomarā ki tāo vujha nā?
latin_ascii: he ahale kitava! tomara kena ivarahima samparke tarka karachay taorata evam injila to taraparei avatirna hayeche, tomara ki tao vujha nay

latin_iast: vastutaḥ tomarāi emana loka ye, ye samparke tomādera kichu jñāna āche, se viṣaẏe to vitarka karecha, tomarā emana viṣaẏe kena vitarka karacha ye viṣaẏe tomādera konai jñāna nei? vastutaḥ āllāhi jñāta āchena, tomarā jñāta nao.
latin_ascii: vastutah tomarai emana loka ye, ye samparke tomadera kichu jnana ache, se visaye to vitarka karecha, tomara emana visaye kena vitarka karacha ye visaye tomadera konai jnana neiy vastutah allahi jnata achena, tomara jnata nao.

latin_iast: ivarāhīma nā iẏāhūdī chila, nā nāsārā, varaṃ ekaniṣṭha ātmasamarpaṇakārī evaṃ se muśarika dalera antarbhukta chila nā.
latin_ascii: ivarahima na iyahudi chila, na nasara, varam ekanistha atmasamarpanakari evam se musarika dalera antarbhukta chila na.

latin_iast: niścaẏa ivarāhīmera saṅge ghaniṣṭhatāẏa sei lokerāi adhika hakadāra yārā tāra anusaraṇa kareche evaṃ ei nāvī, āra yārā īmāna eneche, vastutaḥ āllāha mu’minadera abhibhāvaka.
latin_ascii: niscaya ivarahimera sange ghanisthataya sei lokerai adhika hakadara yara tara anusarana kareche evam ei navi, ara yara imana eneche, vastutah allaha mu’minadera abhibhavaka.

latin_iast: kitāvadhārīdera ekadala cāẏa yāte tomāderake pathabhraṣṭa karate pāre, athaca tārā nijederake chār̤ā anya kāukeo pathabhraṣṭa kare nā, kintu tārā upalavdhi karate pāre nā.
latin_ascii: kitavadharidera ekadala caya yate tomaderake pathabhrasta karate pare, athaca tara nijederake chara anya kaukeo pathabhrasta kare na, kintu tara upalavdhi karate pare na.

latin_iast: he āhale kitāva! kena tomarā āllāhara āẏātaguloke asvīkāra karacha, athaca tomarā nijerāi tāra sākṣī?
latin_ascii: he ahale kitava! kena tomara allahara ayataguloke asvikara karacha, athaca tomara nijerai tara saksiy

latin_iast: he āhale kitāva! kena tomarā satyake mithyāra saṅge miśrita karacha āra jene vujhe satyake gopana karacha.
latin_ascii: he ahale kitava! kena tomara satyake mithyara sange misrita karacha ara jene vujhe satyake gopana karacha.

latin_iast: āhale kitāvera ekaṭā dala valala, yārā īmāna eneche tādera prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tāra upara dinera śurute tomarā īmāna āna evaṃ dinera śeṣe asvīkāra (kupharī) kara, haẏata tārā (isalāma tyāga kare) phire āsave.
latin_ascii: ahale kitavera ekata dala valala, yara imana eneche tadera prati ya avatirna hayeche tara upara dinera surute tomara imana ana evam dinera sese asvikara (kuphari) kara, hayata tara (isalama tyaga kare) phire asave.

latin_iast: ‘evaṃ tomādera dvīnera anusārī chār̤ā āra kāukeo viśvāsa karo nā. tāderake vale dāo, āllāhara (nirdeśita) pathai ekamātra patha; (evaṃ eṭā āllāhara nīti ye) ekadina tomāderake yā deẏā haẏechila tā-i anya kāuke deẏā have athavā anya lokerā tomādera pratipālakera sāmane tomādera viruddhe peśa karāra janya mayavuta pramāṇa peẏe yāve. vala, ‘kalyāṇa āllāharai hāte, tini yāke icche tā dāna karena evaṃ āllāha prācuryaśālī o sarvajña’.
latin_ascii: ‘evam tomadera dvinera anusari chara ara kaukeo visvasa karo na. taderake vale dao, allahara (nirdesita) pathai ekamatra patha; (evam eta allahara niti ye) ekadina tomaderake ya deya hayechila ta-i anya kauke deya have athava anya lokera tomadera pratipalakera samane tomadera viruddhe pesa karara janya mayavuta pramana peye yave. vala, ‘kalyana allaharai hate, tini yake icche ta dana karena evam allaha pracuryasali o sarvajna’.

latin_iast: tini yāke icche nijera daẏāra janya khāsa kare veche nena evaṃ āllāha mahā kalyāṇera adhikārī.
latin_ascii: tini yake icche nijera dayara janya khasa kare veche nena evam allaha maha kalyanera adhikari.

latin_iast: āhale kitāvera madhye keu keu emana āche ye, yadi tādera nikaṭa svarṇera stupa gacchita rākha, tave tomāke tā pherata deve, pakṣāntare tādera keu keu emana ye, ekaṭi dinārao yadi tādera nikaṭa gacchita rākha, tāra pechane lege nā thākale se tomāke tā pherata deve nā, eṭā ejanya ye, tārā vale, ‘nirakṣaradera prati āmādera kona dāẏa-dāẏitva nei’, vastutaḥ tārā jene śune āllāhara samparke mithye vale.
latin_ascii: ahale kitavera madhye keu keu emana ache ye, yadi tadera nikata svarnera stupa gacchita rakha, tave tomake ta pherata deve, paksantare tadera keu keu emana ye, ekati dinarao yadi tadera nikata gacchita rakha, tara pechane lege na thakale se tomake ta pherata deve na, eta ejanya ye, tara vale, ‘niraksaradera prati amadera kona daya-dayitva nei’, vastutah tara jene sune allahara samparke mithye vale.

latin_iast: tave hyā~, ye vyakti nijera oẏā‘dā pūrṇa karave evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kare calave, niścaẏa āllāha (ei) muttākīderake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: tave hya~, ye vyakti nijera oya‘da purna karave evam allahake bhaya kare calave, niscaya allaha (ei) muttakiderake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā āllāhara sāthe kṛta aṅgīkāra evaṃ nijedera śapathake tuccha mūlye vikraẏa kare, erā ākherātera kona aṃśai pāve nā evaṃ āllāha kviẏāmātera dina tādera saṅge kathā valavena nā, tādera prati dṛṣṭipāta karavena nā evaṃ tāderake pavitra karavena nā, vastutaḥ tādera janya āche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: niscaya yara allahara sathe krta angikara evam nijedera sapathake tuccha mulye vikraya kare, era akheratera kona amsai pave na evam allaha kviyamatera dina tadera sange katha valavena na, tadera prati drstipata karavena na evam taderake pavitra karavena na, vastutah tadera janya ache yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: edera madhye ekadala āche yārā kitāvake jihavā dvārā vikṛta kare yāte tomarā tāke kitāvera aṃśa vale mane kara, mūlataḥ tā kitāvera aṃśa naẏa evaṃ tārā vale, ‘eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa, vastutaḥ tā āllāhara nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa naẏa, tārā jene śune āllāhara prati mithyāropa kare.
latin_ascii: edera madhye ekadala ache yara kitavake jihava dvara vikrta kare yate tomara take kitavera amsa vale mane kara, mulatah ta kitavera amsa naya evam tara vale, ‘eta allahara nikata hate avatirna, vastutah ta allahara nikata hate avatirna naya, tara jene sune allahara prati mithyaropa kare.

latin_iast: kona mānava santānera pakṣe eṭā sambhava naẏa ye, āllāha tāke kitāva, jñāna o nuvuoẏāta dāna karena, ataḥpara se lokederake vale, ‘tomarā āllāhake cher̤e āmāra vāndā haẏe yāo, varaṃ (se valave), ‘tomarā āllāhoẏālā hao; yehetu tomarā kitāva śikṣā dāna kara evaṃ nijerāo pāṭha kara’.
latin_ascii: kona manava santanera pakse eta sambhava naya ye, allaha take kitava, jnana o nuvuoyata dana karena, atahpara se lokederake vale, ‘tomara allahake chere amara vanda haye yao, varam (se valave), ‘tomara allahoyala hao; yehetu tomara kitava siksa dana kara evam nijerao patha kara’.

latin_iast: se vyakti tomāderake valave nā ye, tomarā phereśatāderake evaṃ nāvīderake mā’vūdarūpe grahaṇa kara, tomarā musalima haoẏāra parao ki se tomāderake kupharīra nirdeśa dite pāre?
latin_ascii: se vyakti tomaderake valave na ye, tomara pheresataderake evam naviderake ma’vudarupe grahana kara, tomara musalima haoyara parao ki se tomaderake kupharira nirdesa dite parey

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana āllāha nāvīdera nikaṭa hate e aṅgīkāra niẏechilena ye, āmi tomāderake kitāva evaṃ jñāna yā kichu pradāna karechi, ataḥpara tomādera kāche yā āche tāra samarthaka kona rasūla yakhana tomādera nikaṭa āsave, takhana avaśya tomarā tāra prati īmāna ānave evaṃ tāke sāhāyya karave. tini jijñesa karalena, ‘tomarā aṅgīkāra karale to? evaṃ ye viṣaẏe āmi tomādera nikaṭa hate aṅgīkāra nilāma, tomarā tā mānale to?’ tārā valala, ‘āmarā aṅgīkāra karalāma’. āllāha valalena, ‘tomarā sākṣī thāka evaṃ āmio tomādera sāthe sākṣī thākalāma’.
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana allaha navidera nikata hate e angikara niyechilena ye, ami tomaderake kitava evam jnana ya kichu pradana karechi, atahpara tomadera kache ya ache tara samarthaka kona rasula yakhana tomadera nikata asave, takhana avasya tomara tara prati imana anave evam take sahayya karave. tini jijnesa karalena, ‘tomara angikara karale toy evam ye visaye ami tomadera nikata hate angikara nilama, tomara ta manale toy’ tara valala, ‘amara angikara karalama’. allaha valalena, ‘tomara saksi thaka evam amio tomadera sathe saksi thakalama’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yārā mukha phiriẏe nive tārāi hala phāseka.
latin_ascii: atahpara yara mukha phiriye nive tarai hala phaseka.

latin_iast: erā ki āllāhara dvīna chār̤ā anya dvīnera sandhāna karache? athaca āsamāna o yamīne yā āche savai iccheẏa o aniccheẏa tā~rai kāche ātmasamarpaṇa kareche evaṃ tā~rai dike sakalera pratyāvartana.
latin_ascii: era ki allahara dvina chara anya dvinera sandhana karachey athaca asamana o yamine ya ache savai iccheya o aniccheya ta~rai kache atmasamarpana kareche evam ta~rai dike sakalera pratyavartana.

latin_iast: vala, ‘āmarā āllāhara upara evaṃ āmādera prati o ivarāhīma, isamāīla, isahāka, iẏākuva evaṃ tā~ra vaṃśadharera prati yā kichu avatīrṇa haẏeche evaṃ mūsā, īsā o anyānya nāvīgaṇake tā~dera pratipālakera pakṣa hate yā kichu deẏā haẏeche tāra upara īmāna enechi; āmarā tā~dera madhye kona pārthakya kari nā evaṃ āmarā tā~rai kāche ātmasamarpita.’
latin_ascii: vala, ‘amara allahara upara evam amadera prati o ivarahima, isamaila, isahaka, iyakuva evam ta~ra vamsadharera prati ya kichu avatirna hayeche evam musa, isa o anyanya naviganake ta~dera pratipalakera paksa hate ya kichu deya hayeche tara upara imana enechi; amara ta~dera madhye kona parthakya kari na evam amara ta~rai kache atmasamarpita.’

latin_iast: āra ye vyakti isalāma vyatīta anya kona dvīna grahaṇa karate cāive kakṣano tāra sei dvīna kavūla karā have nā evaṃ ākherāte se vyakti kṣatigrastadera antarbhukta have.
latin_ascii: ara ye vyakti isalama vyatita anya kona dvina grahana karate caive kaksano tara sei dvina kavula kara have na evam akherate se vyakti ksatigrastadera antarbhukta have.

latin_iast: āllāha kīrūpe sei sampradāẏake supatha dekhāvena yārā īmāna ānāra para, e rasūlake satya vale svīkāra karāra para evaṃ tādera nikaṭa suspaṣṭa dalīla āsāra para kupharī kare? vastutaḥ āllāha yālima kaomake patha dekhāna nā.
latin_ascii: allaha kirupe sei sampradayake supatha dekhavena yara imana anara para, e rasulake satya vale svikara karara para evam tadera nikata suspasta dalila asara para kuphari karey vastutah allaha yalima kaomake patha dekhana na.

latin_iast: erāi tārā yādera pratiphala ei ye, tādera prati āllāhara, phereśatādera evaṃ samudaẏa mānavera abhisampāta.
latin_ascii: erai tara yadera pratiphala ei ye, tadera prati allahara, pheresatadera evam samudaya manavera abhisampata.

latin_iast: tārā otei cirakāla thākave, tādera śāsti laghu karā have nā evaṃ tāderake virāmao deẏā have nā.
latin_ascii: tara otei cirakala thakave, tadera sasti laghu kara have na evam taderake viramao deya have na.

latin_iast: kintu erapara yārā tāovāha kare evaṃ nijederake saṃśodhana kare tārā vyatīta. niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, ati daẏālu.
latin_ascii: kintu erapara yara taovaha kare evam nijederake samsodhana kare tara vyatita. niscayai allaha ksamasila, ati dayalu.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā īmāna ānāra para kupharī karala, ataḥpara tādera kupharī ver̤ei calala, tādera tāovāha kakṣano kavula karā have nā evaṃ e lokerāi pathabhraṣṭa.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara imana anara para kuphari karala, atahpara tadera kuphari verei calala, tadera taovaha kaksano kavula kara have na evam e lokerai pathabhrasta.

latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā kupharī kare evaṃ sei kāphira avasthāẏai mārā yāẏa, tādera keu pṛthivī-bharā svarṇao vinimaẏa svarūpa pradāna karate cāile tā tāra kācha theke kakṣaṇo grahaṇa karā have nā. erāi tārā yādera janya yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche evaṃ tādera kona sāhāyyakārī nei.
latin_ascii: niscayai yara kuphari kare evam sei kaphira avasthayai mara yaya, tadera keu prthivi-bhara svarnao vinimaya svarupa pradana karate caile ta tara kacha theke kaksano grahana kara have na. erai tara yadera janya yantranadayaka sasti rayeche evam tadera kona sahayyakari nei.

latin_iast: tomarā tomādera priẏavastu kharaca nā karā paryanta kakṣano puṇya lābha karave nā, yā kichu tomarā kharaca kara-niścaẏai āllāha se viṣaẏe khuva bhālabhāvei avagata.
latin_ascii: tomara tomadera priyavastu kharaca na kara paryanta kaksano punya labha karave na, ya kichu tomara kharaca kara-niscayai allaha se visaye khuva bhalabhavei avagata.

latin_iast: tāorāta nāyilera pūrve iẏākuva nijera upara yā hārāma karechila, tāchār̤ā sakala khādya vānī isarāīlera janya hālāla chila. vala, ‘tomarā tāorāta niẏe eso, evaṃ tā pāṭha kara, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao’.
latin_ascii: taorata nayilera purve iyakuva nijera upara ya harama karechila, tachara sakala khadya vani isarailera janya halala chila. vala, ‘tomara taorata niye eso, evam ta patha kara, yadi tomara satyavadi hao’.

latin_iast: eraparao yārā āllāha samparke mithyāropa karave, tārā yālima.
latin_ascii: eraparao yara allaha samparke mithyaropa karave, tara yalima.

latin_iast: vala, ‘āllāha satya valechena, sutarāṃ tomarā ekaniṣṭhabhāve ivarāhīmera anusaraṇa kara, se muśarikadera antarbhukta naẏa’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘allaha satya valechena, sutaram tomara ekanisthabhave ivarahimera anusarana kara, se musarikadera antarbhukta naya’.

latin_iast: niḥsandehe prathama ghara yā mānuṣera janya sthāpana karā haẏechila, tāto makkāẏa, yā varakatamanḍita evaṃ sārā jāhānera janya pathapradarśaka.
latin_ascii: nihsandehe prathama ghara ya manusera janya sthapana kara hayechila, tato makkaya, ya varakatamandita evam sara jahanera janya pathapradarsaka.

latin_iast: tāte suspaṣṭa nidarśanāvalī raẏeche (yemana) mākvāme ivarāhīma(ivarāhīmera dā~r̤ānora jāẏagā). ye keu tāte praveśa karave nirāpada have. āllāhara janya ukta gharera hājja karā lokedera upara āvaśyaka yāra se paryanta pau~chāra sāmarthya āche evaṃ ye vyakti asvīkāra karave, (se jene rākhuka) niḥsandehe āllāha viśva jāhānera mukhāpekṣī nana.
latin_ascii: tate suspasta nidarsanavali rayeche (yemana) makvame ivarahima(ivarahimera da~ranora jayaga). ye keu tate pravesa karave nirapada have. allahara janya ukta gharera hajja kara lokedera upara avasyaka yara se paryanta pau~chara samarthya ache evam ye vyakti asvikara karave, (se jene rakhuka) nihsandehe allaha visva jahanera mukhapeksi nana.

latin_iast: vala, ‘he kitāvadhārīgaṇa! tomarā āllāhara nidarśanasamūhake kena amānya karacha? vastutaḥ tomarā yā karacha, āllāha tāra sākṣī’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘he kitavadharigana! tomara allahara nidarsanasamuhake kena amanya karachay vastutah tomara ya karacha, allaha tara saksi’.

latin_iast: vala, he kitāvadhārīgaṇa! ye vyakti īmāna eneche tāke kena āllāhara pathe vādhā diccha, oke vakra karāra patha khu~jacha, athaca tomarāi (e pathera satyatāra) sākṣī? ematāvasthāẏa āllāha tomādera kāryāvalī samvandhe ve-khavara nana.
latin_ascii: vala, he kitavadharigana! ye vyakti imana eneche take kena allahara pathe vadha diccha, oke vakra karara patha khu~jacha, athaca tomarai (e pathera satyatara) saksiy ematavasthaya allaha tomadera karyavali samvandhe ve-khavara nana.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā yadi kitāvīdera madhya hate kona dalera kathā mene nāo, tave tārā tomādera īmāna ānāra para āvāra tomāderake kāphira vāniẏe chār̤ave.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara yadi kitavidera madhya hate kona dalera katha mene nao, tave tara tomadera imana anara para avara tomaderake kaphira vaniye charave.

latin_iast: āra tomarā kemana kare kupharī karate pāra yakhana tomāderake āllāhara āẏātasamūha par̤e śunāno hacche evaṃ tomādera mājhe tā~ra rasūlao maojuda āchena? ye vyakti āllāhake sudṛr̤habhāve grahaṇa kare, niścaẏai se sarala pathera dike paricālita have.
latin_ascii: ara tomara kemana kare kuphari karate para yakhana tomaderake allahara ayatasamuha pare sunano hacche evam tomadera majhe ta~ra rasulao maojuda achenay ye vyakti allahake sudrrhabhave grahana kare, niscayai se sarala pathera dike paricalita have.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! āllāhake bhaẏa kara yemanabhāve tā~ke bhaẏa karā ucita. tomarā musalima nā haẏe kakṣano maro nā.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! allahake bhaya kara yemanabhave ta~ke bhaya kara ucita. tomara musalima na haye kaksano maro na.

latin_iast: āllāhara rajjuke samavetabhāve dṛr̤habhāve dhāraṇa kara, paraspara vicchinna haẏo nā evaṃ tomādera prati āllāhara ni‘māta smaraṇa kara, yakhana tomarā chile paraspara śatru, tini tomādera antare prītira sañcāra karalena, phale tomarā āllāhara anugrahe paraspara bhāi bhāi haẏe gele. tomarā agni-gahvarera prānte chile, ataḥpara āllāha tomāderake tāttheke rakṣā karalena. ebhāve āllāha nijera nidarśanāvalī tomādera kāche spaṣṭabhāve varṇanā karena yāte tomarā saṭhika patha prāpta hao.
latin_ascii: allahara rajjuke samavetabhave drrhabhave dharana kara, paraspara vicchinna hayo na evam tomadera prati allahara ni‘mata smarana kara, yakhana tomara chile paraspara satru, tini tomadera antare pritira sancara karalena, phale tomara allahara anugrahe paraspara bhai bhai haye gele. tomara agni-gahvarera prante chile, atahpara allaha tomaderake tattheke raksa karalena. ebhave allaha nijera nidarsanavali tomadera kache spastabhave varnana karena yate tomara sathika patha prapta hao.

latin_iast: tomādera madhye emana ekaṭā dala hoka, yārā kalyāṇera dike āhavāna kare, sat kājera ādeśa kare evaṃ asat kāja hate niṣedha kare āra erāi saphalakāma.
latin_ascii: tomadera madhye emana ekata dala hoka, yara kalyanera dike ahavana kare, sat kajera adesa kare evam asat kaja hate nisedha kare ara erai saphalakama.

latin_iast: tomarā sei lokadera mata haẏe yeẏo nā yārā tādera nikaṭa suspaṣṭa nidarśana pau~chāra pare vibhakta haẏeche o matabheda kareche evaṃ e śreṇīra lokedera janya āche mahā śāsti.
latin_ascii: tomara sei lokadera mata haye yeyo na yara tadera nikata suspasta nidarsana pau~chara pare vibhakta hayeche o matabheda kareche evam e srenira lokedera janya ache maha sasti.

latin_iast: se dina kataka mukha ujjvala have āra kataka mukha kālo have, yādera mukha kālo have, (tāderake valā have), tomarā ki īmāna ānāra parao kupharī karechile? kājei nijedera kupharīra janya śāsti bhoga karate thāka.
latin_ascii: se dina kataka mukha ujjvala have ara kataka mukha kalo have, yadera mukha kalo have, (taderake vala have), tomara ki imana anara parao kuphari karechiley kajei nijedera kupharira janya sasti bhoga karate thaka.

latin_iast: yādera mukha ujjvala have, tārā āllāhara rahamatera madhye thākave, tārā tāte cirakāla thākave.
latin_ascii: yadera mukha ujjvala have, tara allahara rahamatera madhye thakave, tara tate cirakala thakave.

latin_iast: esava āllāhara āẏāta, yā ṭhikabhāve āmi tomāke par̤e śunācchi evaṃ āllāha viśvajagatera prati yulama karate cāna nā.
latin_ascii: esava allahara ayata, ya thikabhave ami tomake pare sunacchi evam allaha visvajagatera prati yulama karate cana na.

latin_iast: yā kichu āsamāne āche āra yamīne āche sava āllāharai evaṃ yāvatīẏa viṣaẏādi āllāhara dikei phire yāve.
latin_ascii: ya kichu asamane ache ara yamine ache sava allaharai evam yavatiya visayadi allahara dikei phire yave.

latin_iast: tomarāi sarvottama ummāta, mānavajātira (sarvātmaka kalyāṇera) janya tomādera āvirbhuta karā haẏeche, tomarā satkājera ādeśa dāo evaṃ asat kāja hate niṣedha kara o āllāhara prati īmāna rakṣā kare cala. yadi āhale kitāva īmāna ānata, tāhale niścaẏai tādera janya bhāla hata, tādera madhye keu keu mu’mina evaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai phāseka.
latin_ascii: tomarai sarvottama ummata, manavajatira (sarvatmaka kalyanera) janya tomadera avirbhuta kara hayeche, tomara satkajera adesa dao evam asat kaja hate nisedha kara o allahara prati imana raksa kare cala. yadi ahale kitava imana anata, tahale niscayai tadera janya bhala hata, tadera madhye keu keu mu’mina evam tadera adhikamsai phaseka.

latin_iast: sāmānya kaṣṭa deẏā vyatīta tārā tomādera kona kṣati karate pārave nā, āra yadi tomādera sāthe yuddhe lipta haẏa, tave tomāderake pṛṣṭha pradarśana karave, ataḥpara tārā sāhāyyaprāpta have nā.
latin_ascii: samanya kasta deya vyatita tara tomadera kona ksati karate parave na, ara yadi tomadera sathe yuddhe lipta haya, tave tomaderake prstha pradarsana karave, atahpara tara sahayyaprapta have na.

latin_iast: āllāhara anukampā o mānuṣera āśraẏa chār̤ā yekhānei tārā avasthāna karuka, sekhānei tārā haẏeche lāñchita, tārā āllāhara gayave pariveṣṭita evaṃ tādera upara patita haẏeche dāridrera kaśāghāta. eṭā ejanya ye, tārā āllāhara nidarśanasamūha pratyākhyāna karata evaṃ nāvīgaṇake anyāẏabhāve hatyā karata, eṭā ejanya ye, tārā avādhyatā evaṃ sīmālaṅghana karata.
latin_ascii: allahara anukampa o manusera asraya chara yekhanei tara avasthana karuka, sekhanei tara hayeche lanchita, tara allahara gayave parivestita evam tadera upara patita hayeche daridrera kasaghata. eta ejanya ye, tara allahara nidarsanasamuha pratyakhyana karata evam naviganake anyayabhave hatya karata, eta ejanya ye, tara avadhyata evam simalanghana karata.

latin_iast: tārā savāi samāna naẏa. āhale kitāvadera kata loka emanao āche yārā dvīnera upara pratiṣṭhita āche, tārā rātrikāle āllāhara āẏātasamūha pāṭha kare thāke evaṃ tārā sājadāha kare thāke.
latin_ascii: tara savai samana naya. ahale kitavadera kata loka emanao ache yara dvinera upara pratisthita ache, tara ratrikale allahara ayatasamuha patha kare thake evam tara sajadaha kare thake.

latin_iast: tārā āllāhara o parakālera prati viśvāsa poṣaṇa kare, satkājera ādeśa deẏa evaṃ asatkāja hate niṣedha kare evaṃ kalyāṇakara kāje tatpara thāke. vastutaḥ tārā puṇyavānadera madhye gaṇya.
latin_ascii: tara allahara o parakalera prati visvasa posana kare, satkajera adesa deya evam asatkaja hate nisedha kare evam kalyanakara kaje tatpara thake. vastutah tara punyavanadera madhye ganya.

latin_iast: tārā yā kichu satkāja karuka kona kichui pratyākhyāna karā have nā evaṃ āllāha muttākīdera viṣaẏe viśeṣarūpe parijñāta.
latin_ascii: tara ya kichu satkaja karuka kona kichui pratyakhyana kara have na evam allaha muttakidera visaye visesarupe parijnata.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare, āllāhara nikaṭe tādera dhana-sampada o santāna-santati kakṣano kona kāje āsave nā evaṃ tārā hacche agnira adhivāsī, tārā tāte cirakāla thākave.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare, allahara nikate tadera dhana-sampada o santana-santati kaksano kona kaje asave na evam tara hacche agnira adhivasi, tara tate cirakala thakave.

latin_iast: e pārthiva jīvane tārā yā vyaẏa kare tāra dṛṣṭānta himaśītala vātāsera mata yā nijedera prati yulamakārī sampradāẏera śasyakṣetrake āghāta kare evaṃ tāke naṣṭa kare. mūlataḥ tādera prati āllāha kona prakāra yulama karenani, varaṃ tārā nijerāi nijedera prati yulama kare thāke.
latin_ascii: e parthiva jivane tara ya vyaya kare tara drstanta himasitala vatasera mata ya nijedera prati yulamakari sampradayera sasyaksetrake aghata kare evam take nasta kare. mulatah tadera prati allaha kona prakara yulama karenani, varam tara nijerai nijedera prati yulama kare thake.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā tomādera nijedera loka cher̤e anya kāukeo vandhurūpe grahaṇa karo nā, kāraṇa tārā tomāderake naṣṭa karate truṭi karave nā, tārā kevala tomādera durbhoga kāmanā kare, vastutaḥ tādera mukheo śatrutā prakāśita haẏe par̤e evaṃ tādera antara yā lukiẏe rākhe tā ārao bhaẏaṅkara, āmi tomādera kāche tādera lakṣaṇagulo spaṣṭa kare dilāma, yadi tomarā anudhāvana kara.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara tomadera nijedera loka chere anya kaukeo vandhurupe grahana karo na, karana tara tomaderake nasta karate truti karave na, tara kevala tomadera durbhoga kamana kare, vastutah tadera mukheo satruta prakasita haye pare evam tadera antara ya lukiye rakhe ta arao bhayankara, ami tomadera kache tadera laksanagulo spasta kare dilama, yadi tomara anudhavana kara.

latin_iast: avaśya tomarāi sei loka ye, tomarā tāderake mahavavata kara, kintu tārā tomādera sāthe mahavavata rākhe nā, uparantu tomarā sakala kitāvera pratio viśvāsa rākha evaṃ yakhana tārā tomādera saṅge sākṣāt kare takhana vale ye, ‘āmarāo īmāna enechi’ evaṃ yakhana tārā ekānte milita haẏa takhana tomādera prati gosvāẏa nijedera āṅgulera māthā kāmar̤āte thāke. tāderake vala, ‘tomarā nijedera gosvāẏa marate thāka’. vastutaḥ antare yā āche āllāha tā khuva bhālabhāvei jānena.
latin_ascii: avasya tomarai sei loka ye, tomara taderake mahavavata kara, kintu tara tomadera sathe mahavavata rakhe na, uparantu tomara sakala kitavera pratio visvasa rakha evam yakhana tara tomadera sange saksat kare takhana vale ye, ‘amarao imana enechi’ evam yakhana tara ekante milita haya takhana tomadera prati gosvaya nijedera angulera matha kamarate thake. taderake vala, ‘tomara nijedera gosvaya marate thaka’. vastutah antare ya ache allaha ta khuva bhalabhavei janena.

latin_iast: yadi tomādera kalyāṇa haẏa, tā tāderake duḥkha deẏa, āra yadi tomādera akalyāṇa haẏa, tāte tārā ānandita haẏa, yadi tomarā dhairyaśīla hao evaṃ tākaoẏā avalamvana kara tave tādera cakrānta tomādera kichui kṣati karate pārave nā, niścaẏa tārā yā kichu karache, āllāha tā pariveṣṭana kare āchena.
latin_ascii: yadi tomadera kalyana haya, ta taderake duhkha deya, ara yadi tomadera akalyana haya, tate tara anandita haya, yadi tomara dhairyasila hao evam takaoya avalamvana kara tave tadera cakranta tomadera kichui ksati karate parave na, niscaya tara ya kichu karache, allaha ta parivestana kare achena.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana tumi sakāla velāẏa tomāra parijana hate vera haẏe mu’minaderake yuddhera janya jāẏagāẏa jāẏagāẏa motāẏena karachile, āllāha savakichui śunena, savakichui jānena.
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana tumi sakala velaya tomara parijana hate vera haye mu’minaderake yuddhera janya jayagaya jayagaya motayena karachile, allaha savakichui sunena, savakichui janena.

latin_iast: yakhana tomādera madhyakāra du’dala bhīrutā prakāśa karate manastha karechila, kintu āllāha ubhaẏera vandhu chilena, mu’minadera ucita āllāhara upara bharasā karā.
latin_ascii: yakhana tomadera madhyakara du’dala bhiruta prakasa karate manastha karechila, kintu allaha ubhayera vandhu chilena, mu’minadera ucita allahara upara bharasa kara.

latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha tomādera hīna avasthāẏa vādara yuddhakṣetre tomādera sāhāyya karechena, sutarāṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kare cala, yena tomarā śokaragujāra hate pāra.
latin_ascii: evam allaha tomadera hina avasthaya vadara yuddhaksetre tomadera sahayya karechena, sutaram allahake bhaya kare cala, yena tomara sokaragujara hate para.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana tumi mu’minaderake valachile, ‘tomādera janya ki eṭā yatheṣṭa naẏa ye, tomādera pratipālaka tina sahasra phereśatā avataraṇapūrvaka tomādera sāhāyya karavena?’
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana tumi mu’minaderake valachile, ‘tomadera janya ki eta yathesta naya ye, tomadera pratipalaka tina sahasra pheresata avataranapurvaka tomadera sahayya karavenay’

latin_iast: hyā~, yadi tomarā dhairyadhāraṇa kara evaṃ tākaoẏā avalamvana kara evaṃ tārā (arthāt śatrurā) muhūrtera madhye ekhāne tomādera upara ese par̤e, tāhale tomādera pratipālaka viśeṣabhāve cihnita pā~ca sahasra phereśatā dvārā tomāderake sāhāyya karavena.
latin_ascii: hya~, yadi tomara dhairyadharana kara evam takaoya avalamvana kara evam tara (arthat satrura) muhurtera madhye ekhane tomadera upara ese pare, tahale tomadera pratipalaka visesabhave cihnita pa~ca sahasra pheresata dvara tomaderake sahayya karavena.

latin_iast: eṭā āllāha kevalamātra tomādera susaṃvādera janya evaṃ tā dvārā tomādera citta-praśāntira janya karechena, mūlataḥ sāhāyya to śudhu āllāharai nikaṭa hate, yini parākrānta, prajñāmaẏa.
latin_ascii: eta allaha kevalamatra tomadera susamvadera janya evam ta dvara tomadera citta-prasantira janya karechena, mulatah sahayya to sudhu allaharai nikata hate, yini parakranta, prajnamaya.

latin_iast: yāte tini kāphiradera dalaviśeṣake dhvaṃsa kare dena kiṃvā lāñchita karena, phale tārā nirāśa haẏe pratyāvartana kare.
latin_ascii: yate tini kaphiradera dalavisesake dhvamsa kare dena kimva lanchita karena, phale tara nirasa haye pratyavartana kare.

latin_iast: āllāha tādera prati kṣamāśīla havena athavā tāderake śāsti pradāna karavena- e vyāpāre tomāra kichu karāra nei. kenanā tārā hacche yālima.
latin_ascii: allaha tadera prati ksamasila havena athava taderake sasti pradana karavena- e vyapare tomara kichu karara nei. kenana tara hacche yalima.

latin_iast: ākāśasamūhe o yamīne yā kichui āche sesava āllāharai, tini yāke icche kṣamā karena evaṃ yāke icche śāsti pradāna karena. āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
latin_ascii: akasasamuhe o yamine ya kichui ache sesava allaharai, tini yake icche ksama karena evam yake icche sasti pradana karena. allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā suda kheo nā kramavardhitabhāve, āllāhake bhaẏa kara, yāte tomarā saphalakāma hate pāra.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara suda kheo na kramavardhitabhave, allahake bhaya kara, yate tomara saphalakama hate para.

latin_iast: bhaẏa kara sei āgunake, yā kāphiradera janya prastuta karā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: bhaya kara sei agunake, ya kaphiradera janya prastuta kara hayeche.

latin_iast: āllāhara o rasūlera ānugatya kara, yāte tomarā kṛpāprāpta hate pāra.
latin_ascii: allahara o rasulera anugatya kara, yate tomara krpaprapta hate para.

latin_iast: tomarā druta agrasara hao tomādera pratipālakera kṣamāra dike o sei jānnātera dike yāra vistṛti hacche āsamānasamūha o yamīnera samāna, yā muttākīdera janya tairī karā haẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomara druta agrasara hao tomadera pratipalakera ksamara dike o sei jannatera dike yara vistrti hacche asamanasamuha o yaminera samana, ya muttakidera janya tairi kara hayeche.

latin_iast: yārā sacchala o asacchala avasthāẏa (āllāhara pathe) vyaẏa kare evaṃ yārā krodha saṃvaraṇakārī evaṃ mānuṣera prati kṣamāśīla, āllāha satkarmaśīladera bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: yara sacchala o asacchala avasthaya (allahara pathe) vyaya kare evam yara krodha samvaranakari evam manusera prati ksamasila, allaha satkarmasiladera bhalavasena.

latin_iast: yārā kona pāpa kāja kare phelale kiṃvā nijedera prati yulama karale āllāhake smaraṇa kare evaṃ nijedera pāpera janya kṣamā prārthanā kare evaṃ āllāha vyatīta gunāhasamūhera kṣamākārī kei vā āche evaṃ tārā jene śune nijedera (pāpa) kājera punarāvṛtti kare nā.
latin_ascii: yara kona papa kaja kare phelale kimva nijedera prati yulama karale allahake smarana kare evam nijedera papera janya ksama prarthana kare evam allaha vyatita gunahasamuhera ksamakari kei va ache evam tara jene sune nijedera (papa) kajera punaravrtti kare na.

latin_iast: erāi tārā yādera janya raẏeche tādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate kṣamā evaṃ emana eka jānnāta yāra nimne jharṇādhārā pravāhita, tārā tāra sthāẏī adhivāsī evaṃ satkarmaśīladera puraskāra katai nā uttama!
latin_ascii: erai tara yadera janya rayeche tadera pratipalakera paksa hate ksama evam emana eka jannata yara nimne jharnadhara pravahita, tara tara sthayi adhivasi evam satkarmasiladera puraskara katai na uttama!

latin_iast: tomādera pūrveo aneka sampradāẏa gata haẏeche, tomarā duniẏā paryaṭana kara, tārapara dekha, yārā mithyā va’le amānya karechila tādera pariṇāma kī dā~r̤iẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomadera purveo aneka sampradaya gata hayeche, tomara duniya paryatana kara, tarapara dekha, yara mithya va’le amanya karechila tadera parinama ki da~riyeche.

latin_iast: eṭā hacche mānuṣera janya suspaṣṭa varṇanā evaṃ muttākīdera janya hidāẏāta o nāsīhāta.
latin_ascii: eta hacche manusera janya suspasta varnana evam muttakidera janya hidayata o nasihata.

latin_iast: tomarā hīnavala o duḥkhita haẏo nā, vastutaḥ tomarāi jaẏī thākave yadi tomarā mu’mina hao.
latin_ascii: tomara hinavala o duhkhita hayo na, vastutah tomarai jayi thakave yadi tomara mu’mina hao.

latin_iast: yadi tomāderake āghāta sparśa kare, anurūpa āghāta to apara pakṣakeo sparśa karechila. (jaẏa-parājaẏera) e dinaguloke āmi mānuṣera madhye āvartita kare thāki yāte āllāha mu’minaderake cine nite pārena evaṃ tomādera madhye kāuke kāuke śahīda hiseve grahaṇa karate pārena, vastutaḥ āllāha yālimaderake bhālavāsena nā.
latin_ascii: yadi tomaderake aghata sparsa kare, anurupa aghata to apara paksakeo sparsa karechila. (jaya-parajayera) e dinaguloke ami manusera madhye avartita kare thaki yate allaha mu’minaderake cine nite parena evam tomadera madhye kauke kauke sahida hiseve grahana karate parena, vastutah allaha yalimaderake bhalavasena na.

latin_iast: evaṃ (e janyeo) yena āllāha mu’minaderake saṃśodhana karena o kāphiradera niścihna karena.
latin_ascii: evam (e janyeo) yena allaha mu’minaderake samsodhana karena o kaphiradera niscihna karena.

latin_iast: tomarā ki bhevecha ye, tomarā jānnāte praveśa karave, athaca āllāha ekhana paryantao parakha karenani tomādera madhye ke jihāda kareche āra kārā dhairyaśīla.
latin_ascii: tomara ki bhevecha ye, tomara jannate pravesa karave, athaca allaha ekhana paryantao parakha karenani tomadera madhye ke jihada kareche ara kara dhairyasila.

latin_iast: (śāhādātera) mṛtyura sākṣāt lābhera pūrve tomarā tā kāmanā karate, ekhana to tomarā tā divyadṛṣṭite dekhale.
latin_ascii: (sahadatera) mrtyura saksat labhera purve tomara ta kamana karate, ekhana to tomara ta divyadrstite dekhale.

latin_iast: muhāmmāda hacche ekajana rasūla mātra, tā~ra pūrve ārao aneka rasūla gata haẏeche; kājei yadi se mārā yāẏa kiṃvā nihata haẏa, tave ki tomarā ulṭādike ghure dā~r̤āve? evaṃ ye vyakti ulṭādike phire dā~r̤āẏa se āllāhara konai kṣati karate pārave nā evaṃ āllāha kṛtajñaderake atiśīghra vinimaẏa pradāna karavena.
latin_ascii: muhammada hacche ekajana rasula matra, ta~ra purve arao aneka rasula gata hayeche; kajei yadi se mara yaya kimva nihata haya, tave ki tomara ultadike ghure da~ravey evam ye vyakti ultadike phire da~raya se allahara konai ksati karate parave na evam allaha krtajnaderake atisighra vinimaya pradana karavena.

latin_iast: kona jīvai āllāhara anumati chār̤ā marate pāre nā, tāra meẏāda nirdhārita. ye vyakti pārthiva phala cāẏa, āmi tāttheke tāke dei, āra ye vyakti ākherātera phala cāẏa, āmi tāke tāttheke dei evaṃ kṛtajñaderake āmi śīghrai vinimaẏa pradāna karava.
latin_ascii: kona jivai allahara anumati chara marate pare na, tara meyada nirdharita. ye vyakti parthiva phala caya, ami tattheke take dei, ara ye vyakti akheratera phala caya, ami take tattheke dei evam krtajnaderake ami sighrai vinimaya pradana karava.

latin_iast: kata nāvī yuddha kareche, tādera sāthe chila vahu loka, takhana tārā āllāhara pathe tādera upara saṃghaṭita vipadera janya hīnavala haẏani, durvala haẏani, durvala, apāraga haẏani, vastutaḥ āllāha dhairyaśīladerake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: kata navi yuddha kareche, tadera sathe chila vahu loka, takhana tara allahara pathe tadera upara samghatita vipadera janya hinavala hayani, durvala hayani, durvala, aparaga hayani, vastutah allaha dhairyasiladerake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: tādera mukha hate kevala e kathāi veriẏechila- ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āmādera aparādhagulo evaṃ āmādera kāja-karme vār̤āvār̤iguloke tumi kṣamā kare dāo, āmāderake dṛr̤hapada rekha evaṃ kāphiradalera upara āmāderake sāhāyya kara.’
latin_ascii: tadera mukha hate kevala e kathai veriyechila- ‘he amadera pratipalaka! amadera aparadhagulo evam amadera kaja-karme varavariguloke tumi ksama kare dao, amaderake drrhapada rekha evam kaphiradalera upara amaderake sahayya kara.’

latin_iast: sutarāṃ āllāha tāderake pārthiva suphala pradāna karalena āra parakālīna utkṛṣṭa suphala. āllāha satkarmaśīladerake bhālavāsena.
latin_ascii: sutaram allaha taderake parthiva suphala pradana karalena ara parakalina utkrsta suphala. allaha satkarmasiladerake bhalavasena.

latin_iast: he viśvāsīgaṇa! yadi tomarā kāphiradera ānugatya kara tāhale tārā tomāderake paścāddike phiriẏe niẏe yāve, takhana tomarā kṣatigrasta haẏe par̤ave.
latin_ascii: he visvasigana! yadi tomara kaphiradera anugatya kara tahale tara tomaderake pascaddike phiriye niye yave, takhana tomara ksatigrasta haye parave.

latin_iast: varaṃ āllāhi tomādera abhibhāvaka evaṃ tinii sarvaśreṣṭha sāhāyyakārī.
latin_ascii: varam allahi tomadera abhibhavaka evam tinii sarvasrestha sahayyakari.

latin_iast: atisatvarai āmi kāphiradera antare bhaẏa sañcāra karava, kāraṇa tārā āllāhara śarīka grahaṇa kareche yāra svapakṣe tini konao sanada avatīrṇa karenani, tādera nivāsa have jāhānnāma evaṃ yālimadera nivāsa katai nā jaghanya!
latin_ascii: atisatvarai ami kaphiradera antare bhaya sancara karava, karana tara allahara sarika grahana kareche yara svapakse tini konao sanada avatirna karenani, tadera nivasa have jahannama evam yalimadera nivasa katai na jaghanya!

latin_iast: (uhūdera raṇakṣetre) āllāha tomāderake svīẏa oẏā‘dā saṭhikarūpe dekhālena, yakhana tomarā āllāhara nirdeśe kāphiraderake nipāta karachile, ataḥpara yakhana tomarā nijerāi (pārthiva lābhera vaśe) durvala haẏe gele evaṃ (netāra) hukuma samvandhe matabheda karale evaṃ tomāderake tomādera ākāṅkṣita vastu dekhānora para tomarā avādhya hale, tomādera keu keu duniẏāra pratyāśī hale evaṃ keu keu parakāla cāile, ataḥpara tini tomāderake śatrudera hate phiriẏe dilena tomāderake parīkṣā karāra janya, āllāha avaśya tomāderake kṣamā karalena, vastutaḥ āllāha mu’minadera prati anugrahaśīla.
latin_ascii: (uhudera ranaksetre) allaha tomaderake sviya oya‘da sathikarupe dekhalena, yakhana tomara allahara nirdese kaphiraderake nipata karachile, atahpara yakhana tomara nijerai (parthiva labhera vase) durvala haye gele evam (netara) hukuma samvandhe matabheda karale evam tomaderake tomadera akanksita vastu dekhanora para tomara avadhya hale, tomadera keu keu duniyara pratyasi hale evam keu keu parakala caile, atahpara tini tomaderake satrudera hate phiriye dilena tomaderake pariksa karara janya, allaha avasya tomaderake ksama karalena, vastutah allaha mu’minadera prati anugrahasila.

latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana tomarā u~cu jamira dike uṭhachile evaṃ kārao dike phire tākānora mata hu~śaṭuku tomādera chila nā evaṃ rasūla tomādera paścāte theke tomāderake ḍākachila. phale āllāha tomāderake kaṣṭera upara kaṣṭa pradāna karalena, yāte tomarā yā hāriẏecha athavā tomādera upara ye vipada eseche (tāra kāraṇa upalavdhi karāra para bhaviṣyate) tāra janya duḥkhita nā hao, vastutaḥ tomarā yā-i kara āllāha se vyāpāre viśeṣabhāve avahita.
latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana tomara u~cu jamira dike uthachile evam karao dike phire takanora mata hu~satuku tomadera chila na evam rasula tomadera pascate theke tomaderake dakachila. phale allaha tomaderake kastera upara kasta pradana karalena, yate tomara ya hariyecha athava tomadera upara ye vipada eseche (tara karana upalavdhi karara para bhavisyate) tara janya duhkhita na hao, vastutah tomara ya-i kara allaha se vyapare visesabhave avahita.

latin_iast: ataḥpara kaṣṭera para āllāha tomādera prati śānti-tandrā preraṇa karalena, yā tomādera ekadalake ācchanna karala evaṃ anyadala mūrkhera mato āllāhara prati kudhāraṇā poṣaṇa karataḥ nijerāi nijedera jīvanake udvegākula kare valala, kāja-karmera vyāpāre (siddhānta grahaṇera) āmādera kichumātra adhikāra āche ki? vala, ‘samastai āllāhara niraṅkuśa adhikārabhukta’. tārā emana sava kathā antare poṣaṇa kare- yā tomāra kāche prakāśa kare nā. tārā vale, ‘yadi matāmata pradānera adhikāra āmādera kichumātrao thākata, tāhale āmarā e sthale nihata hatāma nā’. vale dāo, ‘yadi tomarā tomādera ghareo thākate, tathāpi yādera bhāgye mṛtyu lekhā chila, tārā tādera e mṛtyuśayyāra pāne vera haẏe par̤ata’. evaṃ ejanyao ye āllāha tomādera antarera bhetarera viṣaẏagulo parīkṣā karena evaṃ tomādera antarastha viṣaẏaguloke pariṣkāra karena, vastutaḥ āllāha sakalera antarera kathā samparke viśeṣabhāve avahita.
latin_ascii: atahpara kastera para allaha tomadera prati santi-tandra prerana karalena, ya tomadera ekadalake acchanna karala evam anyadala murkhera mato allahara prati kudharana posana karatah nijerai nijedera jivanake udvegakula kare valala, kaja-karmera vyapare (siddhanta grahanera) amadera kichumatra adhikara ache kiy vala, ‘samastai allahara nirankusa adhikarabhukta’. tara emana sava katha antare posana kare- ya tomara kache prakasa kare na. tara vale, ‘yadi matamata pradanera adhikara amadera kichumatrao thakata, tahale amara e sthale nihata hatama na’. vale dao, ‘yadi tomara tomadera ghareo thakate, tathapi yadera bhagye mrtyu lekha chila, tara tadera e mrtyusayyara pane vera haye parata’. evam ejanyao ye allaha tomadera antarera bhetarera visayagulo pariksa karena evam tomadera antarastha visayaguloke pariskara karena, vastutah allaha sakalera antarera katha samparke visesabhave avahita.

latin_iast: du’dala paraspara sammukhīna haoẏāra dina tomādera madhye yārā palāẏanapara haẏechila, tomādera kona kona atīta kāryakalāpera janya śaẏatvāna tādera padaskhalana ghaṭiẏechila evaṃ niḥsandehe āllāha tāderake kṣamā karechena; niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāparāẏaṇa, ati sahanaśīla.
latin_ascii: du’dala paraspara sammukhina haoyara dina tomadera madhye yara palayanapara hayechila, tomadera kona kona atita karyakalapera janya sayatvana tadera padaskhalana ghatiyechila evam nihsandehe allaha taderake ksama karechena; niscayai allaha ksamaparayana, ati sahanasila.

latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā tādera mata haẏo nā, yārā kupharī kare evaṃ tādera bhāi-vandhugaṇa yakhana videśe saphara kare kiṃvā kothāo yuddhe lipta haẏa tādera samvandhe vale, ‘tārā āmādera kāche thākale marata nā, nihatao hata nā’. phale āllāha eṭike tādera manera anutāpe pariṇata kare dena, vastutaḥ āllāhi jīvita karena o mṛtyudāna karena āra tomarā yā kichu kara, āllāha tāra samyaka draṣṭā.
latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara tadera mata hayo na, yara kuphari kare evam tadera bhai-vandhugana yakhana videse saphara kare kimva kothao yuddhe lipta haya tadera samvandhe vale, ‘tara amadera kache thakale marata na, nihatao hata na’. phale allaha etike tadera manera anutape parinata kare dena, vastutah allahi jivita karena o mrtyudana karena ara tomara ya kichu kara, allaha tara samyaka drasta.

latin_iast: yadi tomarā āllāhara pathe nihata hao kiṃvā mṛtyuvaraṇa kara, tave āllāhara daẏā o kṣamā ati uttama tārā yā sañcaẏa kare tāra ceẏe.
latin_ascii: yadi tomara allahara pathe nihata hao kimva mrtyuvarana kara, tave allahara daya o ksama ati uttama tara ya sancaya kare tara ceye.

latin_iast: tomarā mārā gele vā nihata hale avaśyai āllāhara nikaṭa tomāderake ekatrita karā have.
latin_ascii: tomara mara gele va nihata hale avasyai allahara nikata tomaderake ekatrita kara have.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ āllāhara parama anugraha ye tumi tādera upara daẏārdra raẏecha, evaṃ yadi tumi rūr̤ha mejāja o kaṭhina hṛdaẏa hate tave avaśyai tārā tomāra nikaṭa hate sare yeta. sutarāṃ tādera doṣa kṣamā kara evaṃ āllāhara kāche tādera gunāhera janya kṣamā cāo evaṃ kāja-karme tādera saṅge parāmarśa kara, ataḥpara yakhana (kona vyāpāre) saṃkalpavaddha hao, takhana āllāharai prati bharasā kara; niścaẏa āllāha bharasākārīderake pachanda karena.
latin_ascii: sutaram allahara parama anugraha ye tumi tadera upara dayardra rayecha, evam yadi tumi rurha mejaja o kathina hrdaya hate tave avasyai tara tomara nikata hate sare yeta. sutaram tadera dosa ksama kara evam allahara kache tadera gunahera janya ksama cao evam kaja-karme tadera sange paramarsa kara, atahpara yakhana (kona vyapare) samkalpavaddha hao, takhana allaharai prati bharasa kara; niscaya allaha bharasakariderake pachanda karena.

latin_iast: yadi āllāha tomādera sāhāyya karena, tave tomādera upara keui vijaẏī hate pārave nā evaṃ yadi tini tomādera sāhāyya nā karena, se avasthāẏa emana ke āche ye, tomāderake sāhāyya karave? mu’minadera āllāhara prati nirbhara karāi ucita.
latin_ascii: yadi allaha tomadera sahayya karena, tave tomadera upara keui vijayi hate parave na evam yadi tini tomadera sahayya na karena, se avasthaya emana ke ache ye, tomaderake sahayya karavey mu’minadera allahara prati nirbhara karai ucita.

latin_iast: kona nāvī khiẏānāta karate pāre nā, ye vyakti khiẏānāta karave, se khiẏānātakṛta vastusaha kviẏāmātera dina upasthita have, ataḥpara pratyekake yā se arjana kareche tā puropuri deẏā have, kārao prati kona prakāra yulama karā have nā.
latin_ascii: kona navi khiyanata karate pare na, ye vyakti khiyanata karave, se khiyanatakrta vastusaha kviyamatera dina upasthita have, atahpara pratyekake ya se arjana kareche ta puropuri deya have, karao prati kona prakara yulama kara have na.

latin_iast: ye vyakti āllāhara santuṣṭi anusaraṇa kare, se ki āllāhara ākrośe patita lokera nyāẏa hate pāre? tāra nivāsa hala jāhānnāma, āra tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala!
latin_ascii: ye vyakti allahara santusti anusarana kare, se ki allahara akrose patita lokera nyaya hate parey tara nivasa hala jahannama, ara ta katai na nikrsta pratyavartanasthala!

latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa tādera vibhinna maryādā raẏeche, vastutaḥ tārā yā kichui karache, āllāha tāra samyaka draṣṭā.
latin_ascii: allahara nikata tadera vibhinna maryada rayeche, vastutah tara ya kichui karache, allaha tara samyaka drasta.

latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāha mu’minadera prati atyanta anukampā pradarśana karechena, yakhana tādera nikaṭa tādera nijasva ekajanake rasūla kare pāṭhiẏechena, se tāderake āllāhara āẏāta par̤e śunācche, tāderake pariśodhana karache, tāderake kitāva o hikamāta (sunnāha) śikṣā dicche, yadio tārā pūrve suspaṣṭa gomarāhīte chila.
latin_ascii: niscaya allaha mu’minadera prati atyanta anukampa pradarsana karechena, yakhana tadera nikata tadera nijasva ekajanake rasula kare pathiyechena, se taderake allahara ayata pare sunacche, taderake parisodhana karache, taderake kitava o hikamata (sunnaha) siksa dicche, yadio tara purve suspasta gomarahite chila.

latin_iast: kī vyāpāra! tomādera upara yakhana vipada eseche athaca tomarā to (vadara yuddhe tomādera śatrudera) eṭā apekṣā dviguṇa vipada ghaṭiẏechile, ekhana tomarā valacha, ‘eṭā kotheke āsala’? (tāderake) vala, ‘oṭā tomādera nijedera nikaṭa thekei eseche’, niścaẏa āllāha sakala vastura upara kṣamatāvāna.
latin_ascii: ki vyapara! tomadera upara yakhana vipada eseche athaca tomara to (vadara yuddhe tomadera satrudera) eta apeksa dviguna vipada ghatiyechile, ekhana tomara valacha, ‘eta kotheke asala’y (taderake) vala, ‘ota tomadera nijedera nikata thekei eseche’, niscaya allaha sakala vastura upara ksamatavana.

latin_iast: du’dala parasparera sammukhīna haoẏāra dina ye vipada pau~chechila, tā āllāhara hukume ghaṭechila, era uddeśya chila prakṛta mu’minaderake jene neẏā.
latin_ascii: du’dala parasparera sammukhina haoyara dina ye vipada pau~chechila, ta allahara hukume ghatechila, era uddesya chila prakrta mu’minaderake jene neya.

latin_iast: āra munāphikaderakeo jene neẏā. tāderake valā haẏechila; eso, ‘āllāhara pathe yuddha kara, kiṃvā (kamapakṣe) nijedera pratirakṣāra vyavasthā kara’. takhana tārā valala, ‘yadi āmarā jānatāma yuddha have, tāhale avaśyai tomādera anusaraṇa karatāma’. tārā ai dina īmānera ceẏe kupharīrai nikaṭatama chila, tārā mukhe emana kathā vale yā tādera antare nei, yā kichu tārā gopana kare āllāha tā viśeṣarūpe jñāta āchena.
latin_ascii: ara munaphikaderakeo jene neya. taderake vala hayechila; eso, ‘allahara pathe yuddha kara, kimva (kamapakse) nijedera pratiraksara vyavastha kara’. takhana tara valala, ‘yadi amara janatama yuddha have, tahale avasyai tomadera anusarana karatama’. tara ai dina imanera ceye kupharirai nikatatama chila, tara mukhe emana katha vale ya tadera antare nei, ya kichu tara gopana kare allaha ta visesarupe jnata achena.

latin_iast: yārā vase theke nijedera bhāidera samvandhe valate lāgala, āmādera kathāmata calale tārā nihata hata nā. vala, tomarā satyavādī hale tomādera nijedera upara theke maraṇake haṭiẏe dāo.
latin_ascii: yara vase theke nijedera bhaidera samvandhe valate lagala, amadera kathamata calale tara nihata hata na. vala, tomara satyavadi hale tomadera nijedera upara theke maranake hatiye dao.

latin_iast: yārā āllāhara pathe nihata haẏeche, tāderake mṛta bheva nā, varaṃ tārā jīvita, tādera pratipālakera sānnidhye theke tārā riyakaprāpta hacche.
latin_ascii: yara allahara pathe nihata hayeche, taderake mrta bheva na, varam tara jivita, tadera pratipalakera sannidhye theke tara riyakaprapta hacche.

latin_iast: āllāha nija anugrahe tāderake yā diẏechena tā lābha kare tārā ānandita āra ye sava īmānadāra loka tādera pechane (pṛthivīte) raẏe geche, ekhanao tādera sāthe ese milita haẏani, tādera kona bhaẏa o cinte nei jene tārā ānandita.
latin_ascii: allaha nija anugrahe taderake ya diyechena ta labha kare tara anandita ara ye sava imanadara loka tadera pechane (prthivite) raye geche, ekhanao tadera sathe ese milita hayani, tadera kona bhaya o cinte nei jene tara anandita.

latin_iast: āllāhara ni‘māta evaṃ anugrahera kāraṇe tārā ānanda prakāśa kare āra eṭā jene ye, āllāha mu’minadera sāoẏāva vinaṣṭa karena nā.
latin_ascii: allahara ni‘mata evam anugrahera karane tara ananda prakasa kare ara eta jene ye, allaha mu’minadera saoyava vinasta karena na.

latin_iast: āghātaprāpta haoẏāra parao yārā āllāha evaṃ rasūlera ḍāke sār̤ā diẏeche tādera madhye yārā satkāja kare o tākaoẏā avalamvana kare tādera janya raẏeche mahā pratidāna.
latin_ascii: aghataprapta haoyara parao yara allaha evam rasulera dake sara diyeche tadera madhye yara satkaja kare o takaoya avalamvana kare tadera janya rayeche maha pratidana.

latin_iast: yāderake loke khavara diẏechila ye, ekaṭā var̤a vāhinī tomādera viruddhe jar̤a hacche, kājei tāderake bhaẏa kara. takhana tā tādera īmāna vṛddhi kare dila evaṃ tārā valala, ‘āmādera janye āllāhi yatheṣṭa evaṃ tini katai nā uttama karmavidhāẏaka!’
latin_ascii: yaderake loke khavara diyechila ye, ekata vara vahini tomadera viruddhe jara hacche, kajei taderake bhaya kara. takhana ta tadera imana vrddhi kare dila evam tara valala, ‘amadera janye allahi yathesta evam tini katai na uttama karmavidhayaka!’

latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā āllāhara ni‘māta o anugrahasaha phire āsala, konao prakāra aniṣṭa tāderake sparśa kareni, tārā āllāhara santuṣṭira anusaraṇa karechila evaṃ āllāha mahākalyāṇamaẏa.
latin_ascii: atahpara tara allahara ni‘mata o anugrahasaha phire asala, konao prakara anista taderake sparsa kareni, tara allahara santustira anusarana karechila evam allaha mahakalyanamaya.

latin_iast: e lokerā hacche śaẏatvāna; tomāderake tāra vandhudera bhaẏa dekhāẏa, tomarā tāderake bhaẏa karo nā, āmākei bhaẏa kara, yadi tomarā mu’mina hao.
latin_ascii: e lokera hacche sayatvana; tomaderake tara vandhudera bhaya dekhaya, tomara taderake bhaya karo na, amakei bhaya kara, yadi tomara mu’mina hao.

latin_iast: yārā kupharīra dike druta dhāvamāna tārā yena tomāke marmapīr̤ā nā deẏa. tārā kakṣano āllāhara kichui kṣati karate pārave nā. parakāle kona aṃśai āllāha tāderake dite icche karena nā, tādera janya āche mahāśāsti.
latin_ascii: yara kupharira dike druta dhavamana tara yena tomake marmapira na deya. tara kaksano allahara kichui ksati karate parave na. parakale kona amsai allaha taderake dite icche karena na, tadera janya ache mahasasti.

latin_iast: yārā īmānera vinimaẏe kupharī kraẏa kareche, tārā kakṣano āllāhara kichumātra aniṣṭa karate pārave nā, tādera janya āche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: yara imanera vinimaye kuphari kraya kareche, tara kaksano allahara kichumatra anista karate parave na, tadera janya ache yantranadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: kāphiragaṇa yena kichutei e dhāraṇā poṣaṇa nā kare ye, tāderake āmi ye avakāśa diẏechi tā tādera janya maṅgalajanaka; āmi tāderake śudhu ejanya avakāśa dei ye, yena tādera pāpera parimāṇa ver̤e yāẏa, tādera janya āche lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti.
latin_ascii: kaphiragana yena kichutei e dharana posana na kare ye, taderake ami ye avakasa diyechi ta tadera janya mangalajanaka; ami taderake sudhu ejanya avakasa dei ye, yena tadera papera parimana vere yaya, tadera janya ache lanchanadayaka sasti.

latin_iast: asatke sat theke pṛthaka nā karā paryanta tomarā ye avasthāẏa ācha, āllāha mu’minaderake se avasthāẏa cher̤e dite pārena nā evaṃ āllāha tomāderake gāẏivera vidhāna jñāta karena nā, tave āllāha tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera madhye yāke icche veche nena, kājei tomarā āllāha evaṃ tā~ra rasūlagaṇera prati īmāna āna. yadi tomarā īmāna āna āra tākaoẏā avalamvana kara, tāhale tomādera janya āche mahāpuraskāra.
latin_ascii: asatke sat theke prthaka na kara paryanta tomara ye avasthaya acha, allaha mu’minaderake se avasthaya chere dite parena na evam allaha tomaderake gayivera vidhana jnata karena na, tave allaha ta~ra rasulaganera madhye yake icche veche nena, kajei tomara allaha evam ta~ra rasulaganera prati imana ana. yadi tomara imana ana ara takaoya avalamvana kara, tahale tomadera janya ache mahapuraskara.

latin_iast: āllāha nija anugrahe yā tāderake diẏechena tāte yārā kṛpaṇatā kare, tārā yena mane nā kare ye, tā tādera janya kalyāṇakara, varaṃ tā tādera janya (khuvai) akalyāṇakara, tārā yāte kṛpaṇatā kareche, satvara kviẏāmātera dina tārai ver̤i tādera galāẏa pariẏe deẏā have. āsamāna o yamīnera svatvādhikāra kevala āllāharai. tomarā yā kichui karacha āllāha se samparke pūrṇarūpe avahita.
latin_ascii: allaha nija anugrahe ya taderake diyechena tate yara krpanata kare, tara yena mane na kare ye, ta tadera janya kalyanakara, varam ta tadera janya (khuvai) akalyanakara, tara yate krpanata kareche, satvara kviyamatera dina tarai veri tadera galaya pariye deya have. asamana o yaminera svatvadhikara kevala allaharai. tomara ya kichui karacha allaha se samparke purnarupe avahita.
